record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Four units declare LEECH_SEED: Shroomish (1 star), Breloom (2 stars), Lileep (1 star) and Cradily (2 stars); none declares a passive. The strategy is shared; differences are the star index, maxPP and range.
record.summary: The caster heals itself by 20/40/80/160 (requested; by stars, with AP and crit scaling) and applies one poison stack to the cast target for 3000/6000/12000/24000 ms (requested; by stars). The heal is a fixed self-heal; it is not tied to damage dealt by the poison. Poison then deals TRUE damage once per second equal to 5% of the target's max HP per stack, attributed to the caster as poison origin.

targeting.who: heal: the caster; poison: the cast target
targeting.note: The name suggests a drain, but the code heals the caster at cast time and the poison tick does not heal the caster.

effects.scaling: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost 1); x critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT); x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED; x0.5 burn; x0.5 enraged; x1.2 ZENITH weather; Math.round
effects.resolution: applied heal = min(rounded value, missing HP), added to hp; returns 0 with no effect if the caster is wounded; skipped if the caster is protected or dead; overheal on a unit with the GRASS synergy effect adds max HP (0.4 x overheal). Caster healDone counts the effective heal only.

no effect if the target has IMMUNITY_POISON or runeProtect; stacks +1 up to a maximum of 3 (4 if the caster has VENOMOUS, 5 if TOXIC); applied duration = requested after Swift Swim / Hydration / Water Veil / Surge Surfer and Odd Keystone reductions; poison cooldown = max(current, applied)

effects.target: the poisoned target, once per 1000 ms while poison lasts
effects.scaling: 5% of target max HP per stack; rain x0.7; Assault Vest x0.5; TOXIC_BOOST x0.5; Swift Swim x0.7 / Hydration x0.5 / Water Veil or Surge Surfer x0.3; Gliscor passive uses stacks - 2; rounded, minimum 1
effects.resolution: applied through handleDamage as TRUE damage with the poison origin as attacker; takenDamage and shield interaction are in handleDamage (not traced here)

statusEffects.effect: 1 stack, 5% target max HP TRUE damage per stack per second

starBehavior.note: Both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star entry is also the fallback. Listed units are 1 or 2 stars.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy beyond the cast target; range is 1 for Shroomish and Breloom and 2 for Lileep and Cradily.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Single mode. Each cast adds one poison stack (up to the cap) and keeps the longer remaining poison cooldown; poisonOrigin is overwritten by the latest caster.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): heal 20 (1 star) / 40 (2 stars); poison 3000 / 6000 ms. Applied: heal after AP, crit, heal modifiers, rounding and the missing-HP cap; poison duration after reductions, one stack under immunity and stack caps. Poison damage per tick is separate and TRUE.
